name: sonora
description: Native C++ desktop shell hosting a web UI
$comment-baseline: No builtin-baseline on purpose: CI pins the vcpkg commit, local dev uses VCPKG_ROOT. Add a baseline in week 10 when release builds must be byte-reproducible.
$comment-deps: Keep this list minimal. drogon lands in week 11.
$comment-miniaudio: One header, two unrelated halves: the decoders (wav/flac/mp3, pure computation, used by src/audio) and the device backends (WASAPI/CoreAudio/ALSA, used by src/platform). It is the reason the platform layer needs no per-OS audio file.
$comment-sqlite3: The fts5 feature has to be asked for: vcpkg's default sqlite3 is built without it, and a library index with no search is not one. src/library/ says so in the error message if this is ever dropped.
